ROOT_FILES = {".gitignore", "AGENTS.md", "index.html", "package.json", "package-lock.json"}
BUILD_DOCUMENTS = {"docs/attributions.md"}

    return "collaboration" in path.parts and path.suffix == ".ndjson"

    require(not path.is_symlink() and path.is_file(), "A regular, non-symlink file is required")
    require(not protected_stream(path), "Private model streams are stat-only")
    require(path.name != ".npmrc", "Npm configuration requires explicit source/privacy review")
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()

    raw = Path(name)
    if not raw.is_absolute():
        raw = ROOT / raw
    require(not raw.is_symlink(), "Symlinks are not accepted")
    path = raw.resolve()
    require(path.is_relative_to(STAGE), "Named hashes are limited to stage82")
    require(not any(part.lower() in {"secrets", "credentials", "node_modules"} for part in path.parts),
            "Sensitive or dependency directories are outside the named-hash scope")
    require(not path.name.startswith((".env", ".dev.vars")), "Environment secrets are outside scope")
    require(path.name != ".npmrc", "Npm configuration requires explicit source/privacy review")
    require(not protected_stream(path), "Private model streams are stat-only")
    return {"path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": digest_file(path)}

    require(not ((WORKTREE / ".npmrc").exists() or (WORKTREE / ".npmrc").is_symlink()),
            "Project npm configuration needs explicit source/privacy review")
    git_env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("GIT_")}
    git_env.update(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0", GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT="0")
    git_command = ["git", "--no-pager", "--literal-pathspecs", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false"]
    result = subprocess.run(
        [*git_command, "ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"],
        cwd=WORKTREE, env=git_env, capture_output=True, check=True,
    )
    names = sorted(set(name.decode() for name in result.stdout.split(b"\0") if name))
    entries = []

        path = Path(name)

            name in ROOT_FILES or path.suffix in {".ts", ".json", ".jsonc", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".toml"}

        require(full.resolve().is_relative_to(WORKTREE.resolve()), "Source path escaped the worktree")
        entries.append({

    encoded = json.dumps(entries, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
    head = subprocess.check_output([*git_command, "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=WORKTREE, env=git_env, text=True).strip()

    gate = json.loads((CONTROL / "controls-gate.json").read_text())
    require(gate["decision"] == "CONTROLS_APPROVED" and not gate["requiredIssues"], "Control gate is incomplete")
    require(mode in gate["allowedModes"], "This control mode is not approved")
    hashes = gate["controlHashes"]
    for actor in ("main", "astra", "fable"):
        vote = gate["participants"][actor]
        require(vote["decision"] == "CONTROLS_APPROVED" and vote["controlHashes"] == hashes,

    for name, expected in hashes.items():
        require(Path(name).name == name and digest_file(CONTROL / name) == expected, "Control source changed")
    design = json.loads((CONTROL / "design-gate.json").read_text())
    actual = digest_file(WORKTREE / "docs/design/cloudflare-deployment.md")
    require(actual == design["designSha256"], "Design changed")
    require(not design["requiredIssues"], "Design issues remain")
    for actor in ("main", "astra", "fable"):
        require(design["participants"][actor]["decision"] == "DESIGN_APPROVED"

    else:
        require(len(sys.argv) == 3 and sys.argv[1] == "--sha256", "Use --sha256 with one named stage82 file")

def require(condition, message):

def read_json(path):

def write_json(path, value):
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def file_hash(path):
    require(not path.is_symlink() and path.is_file(), "Expected regular control source")
    require(not ("collaboration" in path.parts and path.suffix == ".ndjson"), "Private streams are stat-only")
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def load_control(name):
    path = CONTROL / name
    namespace = {"__file__": str(path), "__name__": "stage82_control"}
    exec(compile(path.read_bytes(), str(path), "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace


def bootstrap():
    # Verify every helper before executing any helper source.
    gate = read_json(CONTROL / "controls-gate.json")
    require(gate["decision"] == "CONTROLS_APPROVED" and not gate["requiredIssues"], "Controls are not approved")
    require("execute" in gate["allowedModes"], "Execution control mode is not approved")
    require("run-validation.py" in gate["controlHashes"], "Runner is not part of approved controls")
    for actor in ("main", "astra", "fable"):
        vote = gate["participants"][actor]
        require(vote["decision"] == "CONTROLS_APPROVED" and vote["controlHashes"] == gate["controlHashes"],
                "Control votes do not agree")
    for name, expected in gate["controlHashes"].items():
        require(Path(name).name == name and file_hash(CONTROL / name) == expected, "Control source changed")
    identity = load_control("stage-identity.py")
    identity["approved_controls"]("execute")
    return identity, load_control("process-ownership.py")


def execution_inputs(identity, check):
    gate = read_json(CONTROL / "source-gate.json")
    require(gate["decision"] == "IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVED" and not gate["requiredIssues"], "Source/plan gate is incomplete")
    plan_path = CONTROL / "execution-plan.json"
    plan_hash = file_hash(plan_path)
    source = identity["source_identity"]()
    require(source["contentDigest"] == gate["sourceDigest"] and plan_hash == gate["planSha256"],
            "Source or execution plan changed")
    for actor in ("main", "astra", "fable"):
        vote = gate["participants"][actor]
        require(vote["decision"] == "IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVED" and vote["sourceDigest"] == source["contentDigest"]
                and vote["planSha256"] == plan_hash, "All3 source/test/plan votes are required")
    plan = read_json(plan_path)
    require(plan["version"] == 1 and check in plan["checks"], "Unknown approved check")
    spec = plan["checks"][check]
    require(isinstance(spec["args"], list) and len(spec["args"]) > 1
            and spec["args"][0] in {"node", "npm", "npx"}, "Expected a reviewed Node command")
    require(all(isinstance(arg, str) and "\0" not in arg for arg in spec["args"]), "Invalid command argument")
    require(isinstance(spec["timeoutSeconds"], int) and 1 <= spec["timeoutSeconds"] <= 7200, "Invalid check timeout")

                and not any(part in name.upper() for part in ("TOKEN", "SECRET", "CREDENTIAL", "PASSWORD")),

def run_directory(name):

    path = RUNS / name
    require(path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink(), "Run directory is missing")

def idle_ports(ports):
    result = []
    for port in ports:
        probe = subprocess.run(["lsof", "-nP", f"-iTCP:{port}", "-sTCP:LISTEN", "-Fpc"],
                               text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=10)
        require(probe.returncode in {0, 1}, "Port metadata lookup failed")
        result.append({"port": port, "idle": probe.returncode == 1, "listenerMetadata": probe.stdout.strip()})
    require(all(item["idle"] for item in result), "A planned local verification port is already in use")
    return result


def assertion(pid, path):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 2
    while True:
        output = subprocess.check_output(["pmset", "-g", "assertions"], text=True, timeout=5)
        lines = [line.strip() for line in output.splitlines() if re.search(rf"\bpid\s+{pid}\(", line)]
        record = {"at": utc(), "pid": pid, "lines": lines,
                  "system": any("PreventSystemSleep" in line for line in lines),
                  "idle": any("PreventUserIdleSystemSleep" in line for line in lines)}

            break

    require(record["system"] and record["idle"], "Owned sleep-prevention assertions are not active")
    return record


def sleep_events(run, began, ended):
    # Ordinary power log, not a model stream. Spool it rather than buffer an OS
    # log in memory; preserve the original until this stage's evidence is saved.
    raw = run / "power-events-raw.log"
    with raw.open("w") as output:
        subprocess.run(["pmset", "-g", "log"], stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True, timeout=15)
    events = []
    pattern = re.compile(r"^(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d [+-]\d{4})\s+(.*)$")
    with raw.open() as stream:

            match = pattern.match(line)

            # whose possible one-second interval overlaps the guarded interval.

        "timestampResolutionSeconds": 1, "boundaryPolicy": "include possible overlap",

            attempt("validation-unlock", lambda: fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN))
            attempt("validation-lock-close", lock.close)
    cleanup = receipt.get("cleanup", {})
    power_cleanup = receipt.get("powerCleanup", {})
    cancelled = cancelled or (run / "cancel-request.json").exists()
    success = (receipt["exitCode"] == 0 and not receipt["error"] and not cancelled
               and cleanup.get("closureKnown") is True and power_cleanup.get("closureKnown") is True
               and not cleanup.get("remaining", []) and not power_cleanup.get("remaining", [])
               and cleanup.get("registryPresent") and cleanup.get("observerAcknowledgements", 0) > 0
               and not cleanup.get("registryErrors") and not cleanup.get("incompleteRegistryRecord"))
    receipt.update({"status": "complete" if success else "cancelled" if cancelled else "failed",
                    "cancelled": cancelled, "endedAt": utc()})
    try:
        write_json(run / "receipt.json", receipt)
    except Exception as error:
        record_error("terminal-receipt", error)
        receipt["status"] = "failed"
        success = False
    print(json.dumps(receipt))
    return 0 if success else 1


def main():
    identity, ownership_module = bootstrap()
    action = sys.argv[1]
    if action == "start":
        require(len(sys.argv) == 3, "Use start CHECK")
        actor = actor_id()
        source, plan_hash, _spec = execution_inputs(identity, sys.argv[2])
        name = f"{sys.argv[2]}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
        require(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9-]+", name), "Invalid check name")
        run = RUNS / name
        run.mkdir()
        request = {"actor": actor, "check": sys.argv[2], "sourceDigest": source["contentDigest"],
                   "planSha256": plan_hash, "requestedAt": utc(), "launcherPid": os.getpid()}
        write_json(run / "request.json", request)
        try:
            with (run / "controller.log").open("w") as output:
                process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, str(CONTROL / "run-validation.py"), "_worker", name],
                                           cwd=ROOT, env=os.environ, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
            print(json.dumps({"run": name, "workerPid": process.pid, "status": "dispatched"}))
        except Exception as error:
            write_json(run / "receipt.json", {"status": "failed", "error": str(error), "actor": actor, "endedAt": utc()})
            raise
        return 0
    if action == "_worker":
        require(len(sys.argv) == 3, "Invalid worker invocation")
        return worker(identity, ownership_module, sys.argv[2])
    require(action in {"wait", "cancel"} and len(sys.argv) in {3, 4}, "Use wait RUN [SECONDS] or cancel RUN")
    run = run_directory(sys.argv[2])
    request = read_json(run / "request.json")
    require(request["actor"] == actor_id(), "Cannot operate another actor's validation")
    if action == "cancel":
        with (run / "launch.lock").open("a") as boundary:
            fcntl.flock(boundary, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
            write_json(run / "cancel-request.json", {"actor": actor_id(), "at": utc()})
        print(json.dumps({"run": run.name, "status": "cancellation-requested"}))
        return 0
    seconds = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) == 4 else 45
    require(0 <= seconds <= 45, "Wait at most45 seconds per call")
    until = time.monotonic() + seconds
    while True:
        receipt = read_json(run / "receipt.json") if (run / "receipt.json").exists() else {"status": "starting"}
        if receipt.get("status") in TERMINAL or time.monotonic() >= until:
            print(json.dumps(receipt))
            return 0
        time.sleep(0.25)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
